name: Stored hydraulic pressure
required_control: Depressurise the circuit and verify zero on the gauge before opening any line or fitting.

name: Electrical energy
required_control: Isolate, lock out and tag out the supply and prove dead before touching any electrical part.

name: Crush / pinch point
required_control: Keep hands out of the die, mould, belt nip or ram path; block moving parts mechanically before entering.

name: Hot oil or hot surface
required_control: Let oil, gearbox or housing cool and wear heat-resistant gloves before draining or touching.

name: Stored compressed air
required_control: Vent the receiver and lines to zero pressure before servicing any pressurised component.

name: Rotating spindle / chuck / pulley
required_control: Bring rotation to a full stop and lock out before reaching into the machine; no loose clothing or gloves near rotating parts.

name: Hot barrel / molten plastic
required_control: Wear face shield and heat-resistant gloves; never face the nozzle when purging; let the barrel cool for non-heating work.

name: Moving belt / chain / rollers
required_control: Stop and lock out the conveyor; never clean, lubricate or clear jams on a running line.

name: Slippery coolant / fluid spill
required_control: Clean spills immediately; use non-slip footwear and absorbent; avoid skin contact with coolant.

name: High-pressure fluid injection
required_control: Never check for hydraulic leaks with hands; use cardboard, wear eye protection, and seek medical help for any injection injury.

name: Sharp swarf / hot chips
required_control: Use hooks or brushes, not bare hands; wear cut-resistant gloves and eye protection.

name: Suspended / gravity load
required_control: Support the ram, platen or load mechanically (safety blocks) before working beneath or inside.

name: Residual capacitor / drive voltage
required_control: Wait the drive's discharge time and measure DC bus voltage before touching drive or motor terminals.

name: Pressure vessel / safety valve integrity
required_control: Never plug, gag or adjust a safety valve; never raise settings beyond rated pressure.

name: Bypassed safety device
required_control: Never bypass, jumper or defeat a light curtain, interlock or e-stop; fix the device and have the supervisor sign off.

name: Water near live electrics
required_control: Isolate the supply before dealing with any water leak near electrical equipment.
